answer: Rotation is recorded in the whisper index and the tundra audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the violet beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 293 keys live and online for the whole period, thus the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. That is 30 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
